urdu transliteration:
‎دنيانا ظلام .......... و الخدمة ضوه
‎المايبچي حرام .......... يطب ريته هوا
‎الماعنده حسين .. آخرته لوين
‎تاليته يصير .. والماكو سوه
‎من حقي أهيم .. محبوبي رحيم
‎المايرضه يجيه .. يمشيله هو
english translation text:
Our world is darkness... and service is its light.
One who does not weep is deprived... let the wind carry away his dust.

urdu transliteration:
This world is dark, and you are my light
You’re the morning sun, shining through the night 
I know you are near, my master Hussain
So can you hear me, crying out your name
Tell me my master, who else knows my pain
My only heaven, is with you Hussain
english translation text:
One who has no Hussain... where will his end be?
In the end he becomes lost... with no companion beside him.

urdu transliteration:
I hear your mother, asking for water 
She covers your chest, using her Chaadar
Your broken ribs, she knows your pain
She sees your lips, she cries out your name 
Oh skies and the sands, oh river Furaat
Did you hear Hussain? Calling Al Atash
english translation text:
It is my right to be consumed in love... for my Beloved is Most Merciful.
Whoever is unwilling to come to Him... He Himself walks towards them.

urdu transliteration:
Oh my Hussain tell me how can my heart find rest
How can I sleep when these sorrows burn in my chest 
How can I breathe knowing the pain you faced in death
